name: Interlace Design System
summary: Shadcn registry of 146 React components with published contracts: RSC boundary, min viewport, keyboard path, semver.
description: A design-system registry served over the shadcn registry protocol: 146 installable React components in tiers (theme, primitive, pattern, template, chart, effect, starter, util), installed as plain source with the shadcn CLI. Every item publishes its contract — RSC boundary, minimum viewport, keyboard path, modelled state union, semver — plus a shared theme baseline with tokens, a WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 focus ring and reduced-motion support. Built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4, MIT licensed, with a machine-readable index for agents.
